# Language Fixture

## Punctuation and formatting

The fixture holds the two headings the fixture rule cites.

## Words to avoid or examine

| Term | Repair | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `leverage`, `leverages` | use | FAIL |
| `seamless`, `seamlessly` | state which step the user no longer takes | FAIL |

```text
# A comment in a fence is no heading
```
